title.zh: 爆炸荷載與安全距離評估
title.en: Blast Load and Safety Distance Assessment

desc.zh: 廠區、儲能設施、彈藥庫或關鍵設施的爆炸情境分析，評估超壓分布與安全量距。
desc.en: Explosion scenario analysis for plants, energy storage sites, magazines and critical facilities: overpressure maps and safe separation distances.

deliver.zh: 交付：評估報告、風險分區圖
deliver.en: Deliverables: assessment report, hazard zoning map

title.zh: 抗爆設計檢核與補強建議

desc.zh: 依 UFC 3-340-02 等國際規範，檢核構件與結構的抗爆能力並提出補強方案。
desc.en: Checking members and structures against UFC 3-340-02 and other standards, with retrofit recommendations.

deliver.zh: 交付：檢核計算書、補強設計建議

desc.zh: 為塗料、纖維、混凝土與複合材料廠商進行靜態、衝擊與爆炸試驗，取得可對外引用的性能數據。
desc.en: Static, impact and explosive testing for coating, fiber, concrete and composite manufacturers, producing citable performance data.

deliver.zh: 交付：試驗報告、數值模型參數
deliver.en: Deliverables: test report, numerical model parameters

title.zh: 工程審查、顧問與教育訓練

desc.zh: 防護設施基本與細部設計審查、技術諮詢，以及抗爆設計與爆炸模擬的專業研習課程。
desc.en: Design reviews for protective facilities, technical consulting, and professional courses on blast design and simulation.

deliver.zh: 交付：審查意見、顧問報告、課程
deliver.en: Deliverables: review comments, consulting reports, courses
